title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - MaintenanceSubscription
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/MaintenanceSubscription. A maintenance subscription gives access to bug fixes, security fixes and function updates from the software vendor.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MaintenanceSubscription'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

subscriptionIncluded.description: Property. Whether the cloud service provider has prepared the image to receive bug fixes, security fixes, and function updates. Default: false.

subscriptionRequired.description: Property. Whether the cloud service user needs a maintenance subscription account from the OS vendor to receive fixes. Default: false.

maintainedUntil.description: Property. Date (UTC) through which the OS vendor guarantees maintenance support.
